Invites and Email
The Bazaar Open Jam invites sheet is the one list of people.
Column D is how many jams that person has joined, counting up over time.
Each date has its own block of columns: invited, coming, came, chased, note.
Under coming, 1 is yes, 0 is no and .5 is a maybe. Under came, a tick turned up and a dash said yes and did not.
Column E marks the people who have never once replied.
The last three columns count, across all jams, how many invitations each person answered and how many they declined.
Every jam thread is in Gmail under vamp jam or open jam in the subject.
The Oct 24 thread is the live one, and the one I forward from when I remind people.
